notes: The first of the three Russian Hill district nominations Anne Bloomfield wrote for the Russian Hill Neighbors in May 1987. A small inventory — nineteen resources on one half-block — but every building carries a date and most a named contractor or architect, and the section 8 statement places four notable past residents at numbers. Owner names in each building's title are not taken; the notable ones are, per issue #310.

coverage.remaining: Of the five 1982-1989 district nominations, none remains once this batch and its two Russian Hill companions are read. Still unread in this source: 89000319 (Southern Pacific Company Hospital), the 68 listings certified 1990 or later, and 77000334, 01000281 and 100008228.
coverage.note: Russian Hill/Macondray Lane District (87002286, Anne Bloomfield, May 1987) read whole: section 7's per-building descriptions, section 8's per-building significance entries, the endnotes and the owners table. 19 sketch-map resources, 18 of them buildings or the lane. 28 findings: 22 construction, alteration, fire and demolition facts, 4 notable past residents (Charles Caldwell Dobie, Giuseppe Cadenasso, Anita Whitney, Luigi DeMartini), 1 dated publication and 1 renaming of the lane. Not extracted: 80 Macondray Lane (c.1937, designer unknown — a bare date), the 1987 owners table (current owners), and the original owners the building names carry (a harness maker, a widow, a physician, a glassworker) — ordinary owners, not notable occupants. Section 7 and section 8 number the Macondray buildings differently from no. 13 on; the owners table and block/lot follow section 7's numbering. Section 8's text names Ina Coolbrith, Eleanor Ross and others as past residents of the district without placing them at a number; Coolbrith's address is placed by the Vallejo Street Crest nomination instead.

findings.description: The lane was renamed from Lincoln to Macondray, after the pioneer merchant Frederick W. Macondray; its right-of-way appears in part on the 1859 Coast Survey map.

citation.label: National Register of Historic Places nomination, Russian Hill/Macondray Lane District (reference number 87002286), National Park Service.
citation.locator: section 8 continuation p.9, sketch map no. 11

raw.text: About 1912 the name was changed from 'Lincoln 1 to 'Macondray, 1 for pioneer San Francisco merchant Frederick W. Macondray

resolution.method: The record states no street number, so there is nothing to look up in sf-eas-addresses.
